    Job highlights

    Identified by Google from the original job post

    Qualifications

    • Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
    • 2 years of experience in program management
    • Experience working with Generative AI within a program management capacity
    • Experience working with or on Trust & Safety teams
    • 1 more items(s)

    Benefits

    • The US base salary range for this full-time position is $122,000-$178,000 + bonus + equity + benefits
    • Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location
    • The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations

    Responsibilities

    • As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish
    • You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company
    • You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers
    • Responsibilities: Articulate every program's problem statement, scope, deliverables, success metrics, roles and responsibilities, and timelines
    • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Trust & Safety and Google, align stakeholders on decisions and changing circumstances including designing and enabling predictable, effective, tailored information flow, including delivering regular program updates
    • Collaborate with partners to identify and execute on program tasks to achieve milestones and outcomes on time
    • Anticipate and overcome risks to program timelines and/or quality and develop change management roll-out plans
    • Determine program phasing and metrics that effectively drive continuous improvement, provide transparency into and rationale for program pivots
    • Assess engineering problems, understand the interplay between program and technical issues, and contribute to shaping technical directions

    This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.
    Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

    Experience worki    ...ng with or on Trust & Safety teams.
    A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
    Our goal is to build a Google that looks like the world around us — and we want Googlers to stay and grow when they join us. As part of our efforts to build a Google for everyone, we build diversity, equity, and inclusion into our work and we aim to cultivate a sense of belonging throughout the company.
    The US base salary range for this full-time position is $122,000-$178,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
    Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
    Responsibilities: Articulate every program's problem statement, scope, deliverables, success metrics, roles and responsibilities, and timelines.
    Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Trust & Safety and Google, align stakeholders on decisions and changing circumstances including designing and enabling predictable, effective, tailored information flow, including delivering regular program updates.
    Collaborate with partners to identify and execute on program tasks to achieve milestones and outcomes on time. Anticipate and overcome risks to program timelines and/or quality and develop change management roll-out plans.
    Determine program phasing and metrics that effectively drive continuous improvement, provide transparency into and rationale for program pivots.
    Assess engineering problems, understand the interplay between program and technical issues, and contribute to shaping technical directions.

    Qualifications

    • The AI Developer will be responsible for tasks related to pattern recognition, neural networks, software development, machine learning, and natural language processing

    More job highlights

    Job description

    Company Description

    Welcome to Neural Navigators, your trusted AI consultancy partner based in Houston, TX. We plan on guiding businesses through the transformative power of artificial intelligence, offering tailored solutions that drive growth, efficiency, and innovation. With expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and more, our plan is to empower organizati    ...ons to unlock new opportunities, save money, and save time in this new digital age.

    Role Description
    • This is a full-time hybrid role for an Artificial Intelligence Developer at Neural Navigators. The AI Developer will be responsible for tasks related to pattern recognition, neural networks, software development, machine learning, and natural language processing. You will be refining or building your own model to match certain market needs (e.g. automating accounting tasks, automating CRM processes, consolidation, leads generation, etc.) While the role is primarily located in Houston, TX, remote work is acceptable.

    Qualifications
    • Pattern Recognition and Neural Networks expertise
    • Strong background in Computer Science and Software Development
    • Strong experience with Python and building/refining AI models
    • Experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Speech to Text (STT)
    • Problem-solving and analytical skills
    • Ability to work both independently and in a team
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
    • Experience with AI frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorcH

    I am looking for a partner who is open to equity-based compensation during the initial stages of the business. We will negotiate a future salary before hiring, with clear revenue milestones that will determine compensation. As the business grows and reaches specific financial targets, your salary will be adjusted based on earnings and projections, ensuring fair compensation aligned with the company’s success.

    Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Technologies & Architecture Leader

    Talentfish • Naperville, IL • via Teal
    Full-time
    Apply on Teal

    Job highlights

    Identified by Google from the original job post

    Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field
    • 5 to 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related roles
    • Proficient in AI/ML programming languages
    • Strong knowledge of AI/ML concepts such as supervised learning and deep learning
    • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch
    • Experience with large datasets and big data technologies
    • Experience in managing AI/ML pipelines and workflows
    • Excellent communication and presentation skills
    • Experience applying DevOps principles to AI/ML engineering
    • Ability to work in a global and matrixed environment
    • Certification in AI/ML solutions & architecture
    • 8 more items(s)

    Benefits

    • Direct hire position
    • Hybrid work model (3 days onsite)

    Responsibilities

    • This senior-level role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to architect impactful solutions, manage AI/ML operations, and lead a team of engineers and data scientists under a factory model approach
    • Analyze business requirements and processes to translate them into AI/ML solutions
    • Design and implement end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, including data ingestion, model development, and deployment
    • Apply best practices for AI/ML engineering, including code quality and continuous integration
    • Select and utilize appropriate AI/ML frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow and Azure
    • Research and evaluate the latest AI/ML techniques to solve business problems
    • Design and document solution architecture, focusing on integration and performance
    • Review and approve detailed solution design artifacts
    • Test and validate solutions to ensure they meet quality standards
    • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the development team
    • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders to define AI/ML objectives
    • Manage the AI/ML operations team to ensure solution quality and reliability
    • Establish best practices and standards for AI/ML development and deployment
    • Monitor and evaluate the performance of AI/ML solutions and provide recommendations for improvement
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to Digital Partners and leadership on technology matters
    • 12 more items(s)
    More job highlights

    Job description

    About the position

    The Leader of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Technologies & Architecture is responsible for managing, designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI and ML solutions to drive digital transformation and innovation across various business functions. This senior-level role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to architect impactful solutions, manage AI/ML    ... operations, and lead a team of engineers and data scientists under a factory model approach.

    Responsibilities
    • Analyze business requirements and processes to translate them into AI/ML solutions.
    ,
    • Design and implement end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, including data ingestion, model development, and deployment.
    ,
    • Apply best practices for AI/ML engineering, including code quality and continuous integration.
    ,
    • Select and utilize appropriate AI/ML frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow and Azure.
    ,
    • Research and evaluate the latest AI/ML techniques to solve business problems.
    ,
    • Design and document solution architecture, focusing on integration and performance.
    ,
    • Review and approve detailed solution design artifacts.
    ,
    • Test and validate solutions to ensure they meet quality standards.
    ,
    • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the development team.
    ,
    • Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders to define AI/ML objectives.
    ,
    • Manage the AI/ML operations team to ensure solution quality and reliability.
    ,
    • Establish best practices and standards for AI/ML development and deployment.
    ,
    • Monitor and evaluate the performance of AI/ML solutions and provide recommendations for improvement.
    ,
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to Digital Partners and leadership on technology matters.

    Requirements
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
    ,
    • 5 to 7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related roles.
    ,
    • Proficient in AI/ML programming languages.
    ,
    • Strong knowledge of AI/ML concepts such as supervised learning and deep learning.
    ,
    • Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch.
    ,
    • Experience with large datasets and big data technologies.
    ,
    • Experience in managing AI/ML pipelines and workflows.
    ,

    ,
